text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! Suuummeeeerrr!!
My summer vacation is hereee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not... summer vacation. Summer training camp is a crucial
strengthening event for Umamusume. But—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bestieee!! You and me are partying for real this summer☆
And from there, I'll go find a brand-new me♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Totally! Life round two, let's make it count from here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—A summer for a fresh start.
Mejiro Palmer seems determined to use this summer
to reinvent herself anew.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a brand-new Palmer, capable of venturing forth without fearing failure.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, like... Palmer-chin, you're a Mejiro,
so ever since you were a kid, you always had that
pressure to run, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Is that your real dream? Didn't you have anything else you wanted to do besides running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"A dream other than running, huh...
Now that you mention it... hmm."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of Umamusume who don't race, though.
So honestly, who knows?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it okay if I reconsider
from that point on?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hypothetically... just hypothetically, okay?
Even if you wanted to pursue a different dream outside of racing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I think for a moment. And then—
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I think that's fine.
If that's the case, I think that's totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A fresh start. If one is to truly be reborn,
one must first confirm their genuine, unadulterated feelings."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got it! This summer, I'm gonna try all sorts of things to find out what I truly love.
So...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm down, besties for life!
This summer's gonna be an mega-heaped pile of fun activities!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha☆ Then let's hit the Hakodate Kinen like it's a vacay!
Sightseeing included, obvs♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Priority on having fun. Beyond that,
I'm sure Mejiro Palmer will find what she
truly wants to do as well."
